home.about.label: About us
home.about.title: Fine dining|with a homely soul
home.about.alt: Two cooks in aprons smiling next to a table with ingredients
home.about.p1: Soul Catering was born in Valencia, founded by two chefs trained at fine-dining schools, with years of experience in the kitchens of five-star hotels and Michelin-starred restaurants in Spain and France.
home.about.p2: There we learned precision, respect for the product and the rhythm of flawless service. Then we wanted to take all of that outside the restaurant: to weddings, country estates, offices and private homes.
home.about.p3: Today we work with a kitchen and front-of-house team that has served hundreds of events, from intimate lunches for twenty people to banquets for several hundred guests.
home.about.p4: We cook with seasonal produce from the Valencian huerta and trusted suppliers, and we adapt every menu to your guests' allergies and tastes. Because a great celebration is remembered for how it made you feel.
